summary: Example RPM spec that installs the acme.webserver collection into the system collections path and copies each role into /usr/share/ansible/roles with a my-standalone-role. prefix, plus docs and license files.
questions: What does an RPM spec for packaging a collection plus standalone roles look like?

answer_card.title: Example RPM spec for collection and roles
answer_card.answer_md:
Key parts of `%install`:
```text
%global collection_dir %{_datadir}/ansible/collections/ansible_collections/acme/webserver
mkdir -p %{buildroot}/%{collection_dir}
cp -r ./* %{buildroot}/%{collection_dir}/
mkdir -p %{buildroot}/%{_datadir}/ansible/roles
for role in %{buildroot}/%{collection_dir}/roles/*; do
  cp -pR ${role} %{buildroot}/%{_datadir}/ansible/roles/my-standalone-role.$(basename ${role})
done
```
README, COPYING and LICENSE files are copied to `%{_pkgdocdir}`.
